The Sun, Moon, and Stars," and students echo each verse after the teacher reads it: "they should echo each verse as you read it a second time. Remind students of the gestures and hand motions that they created in the previous lesson." This echo-reading constitutes a scaffolded, partial recitation of a poem — the student speaks the poem's words aloud but only by echoing the teacher verse-by-verse, not reciting independently from memory or from the text on their own. The optional choral re-read ("invite students to read the poem with you one last time") is similarly teacher-led. No speech is present in the lesson.
